text:
maria: heads-up — short-chat p95 CPU drift after last transport patch, digging in now.
sam: can you drop a perf snippet?
maria: quick perf top capture:
```
 samples  %   proc   so               symbol
 3800   34% hostd  libc.so.6         __writev
 1100   10% hostd  grpc_core.so      grpc_call_start_batch
 900     8% hostd  host_tokenizer    tokenize_batch
 600     5% hostd  host_kv           kv_lookup
```
maria: writev is huge, plus grpc start batch. kv_lookup climbed too.
achalex: small-iovec storm after the http2 header packing change? writev gets many tiny iovs -> syscall and iovec handling overhead.
cheng: selector note: it's using windowed avg_seq_len to pick kernels. single-request bursts get misclassified and pick throughput kernels. that increases decode warmup cost.
priya: also saw kv hotset churn when pretokenize toggles flip key formats. mixed key formats = eviction storms.
sam: proposed quick patch bundle (small, host-side):
- transport: iov coalescer that merges adjacent small iovs up to config max (default 3KB)
- ingress: `pretokenize_min_tokens` flag (default 32) to skip pretokenize for tiny requests
- kernel selector: per-batch override: if candidate_batch_size==1 && max_seq_len < 48 -> prefer low-latency kernel
- kvcache: stable raw-request hash for keying when pretokenize is skipped
maria: microbench on short-chat (10k qps):
```
baseline: cpu 100%, p50 20ms, p95 280ms
coalesce only: cpu 92%, p50 21ms, p95 230ms
coalesce + skip: cpu 85%, p50 22ms, p95 170ms
all + selector tweak: cpu 80%, p50 22ms, p95 140ms
```
(throughput same)
achalex: good tradeoff — tiny median bump, big tail win. low-risk changes.
cheng: add metrics: `transport.iov_coalesced_count`, `ingress.preparse_skipped_total`, `selector.lowlat_forced_total`. Add alerts: coalesce_ratio < 0.7, big p50 regression on large requests.
priya: I'll own kvcache normalization. small note: ensure backwards compatibility for existing keys; we should only switch key format for newly cached entries and have a TTL-handover.
maria: sample config toggle snippet:
```
# ingress-runtime.yaml
pretokenize_min_tokens: 32
transport:
  coalesce_enabled: true
  coalesce_max_bytes: 3072
selector:
  force_lowlat_for_singletons: true
```
sam: infra-bot, kick a canary with short-chat traffic (10k rps) when ready.
infra-bot: Canary started at 1769994500 on canary-pool-7 (30m window). Routing short-chat 10k rps. Will post summary.
infra-bot: Canary summary (30m):
- host_cpu: -12.7%
- p50_lat: +0.6ms
- p95_lat: -36%
- kv_evictions/min: -28%
- transport.iov_coalesced_count: 16.4k
- ingress.preparse_skipped_total: 13.9k
maria: Nice. Plan: land four small PRs, default canary flags on, gate via runtime feature flags. Roll Dedicated -> Hosted. Add 24h canary in eu-west.
priya: tests: unit for coalescer (preserve iov order, respect max bytes), selector unit tests (singleton override), integration test for kvcache key handover.
cheng: also add nightly perf job for short-chat trace to detect regressions faster.
sam: I'll update dashboards and create the alert rules. will run 24h smoke and post results.
achalex: one more thing — make sure writev coalescer doesn't introduce extra copying for large numbers of iovs; prefer composing iovec vectors when possible. add microbench for max_iov counts.
maria: noted. owners: alex transport, priya kvcache, cheng selector, sam perf. PRs incoming and will link here.
